items.title: The local cohomology of the principal opens in a multiplicative set recovers the module in degree zero and vanishes in degree one
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the filtered colimit of the local cohomology of the principal opens determined by a multiplicative set: the degree zero parts recover the module when the module is localised to zero, and the degree one parts vanish (author lemma at source lines 434-440, label lemma-multiplicative). The proof (source lines 442-449) disposes of degree zero from the definitions, then uses commutation of the two functors with filtered colimits to reduce the degree one assertion to the case of a module annihilated by a single element of the multiplicative set, where the vanishing of the chapter on torsion modules applies. The colimit reduction and the appeal to the torsion vanishing are the content. H2.
